content.short: Digital wallet and money transfer service.
content.description: Skrill is a long-established digital wallet and money-transfer service, part of the Paysafe group, that lets people pay online, send money internationally, and manage funds across borders. Users get a multi-currency wallet, a prepaid card, low-cost international transfers, and the ability to pay at millions of online merchants, with a loyalty program rewarding frequent activity. Skrill also offers in-app buying and selling of cryptocurrencies and exposure to digital assets for consumers who want to trade alongside everyday payments. Popular with online shoppers, gamers, traders, and people sending remittances, Skrill focuses on fast, global money movement from a single account. As one of the earlier e-wallets, it continues to compete with newer neobanks and transfer apps on international payments and everyday digital spending.
content.meta: Skrill is a digital wallet for online payments, transfers, and crypto. Discover Skrill and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
